To multiply the numbers 123,456,789,123,456,789 and 987,654,321,987,654,321 exactly, we perform the multiplication directly:

\[ 123456789123456789 \times 987654321987654321 = 121932631356500531347203169112635269 \]

This is the exact product of the two numbers.
